companionScript.title: What’s in front of you
companionScript.body: Delco PR-0014 is #1. Soft Ask draft is ready — warm call plus proposal link for Puneet. Fixed $29,807 / Folding $44,232 pretax. Nothing has been sent. AI stays OFF.

companionScript.title: Why it matters tonight
companionScript.body: Competitors (Knapheide + Adrian) are already in play. Stall clock ~48h since inbound. Eleven jobs wait on your GO elsewhere — Delco is still the close that moves first.

companionScript.title: Your call — GO or HOLD
companionScript.body: GO on this deck only queues a stub toast for you — no Wrapstart send, no Gmail, no SMS. Real Soft Ask stays in Wrapstart or your draft when you choose. HOLD parks it safely.

companionScript.title: If they accept
companionScript.body: After accept → 50% deposit invoice on all-in (Fixed ≈ $16,126 / Folding ≈ $23,930). Quotes carry no deposit line. Then Design opens. No free art on a handshake.

thinkPath.detail: deposit_required=false on quote. After accept → invoice 50% of all-in (Fixed ≈$16,126 / Folding ≈$23,930). THEN Design. No free art. No design on handshake.
